_comment: Yellow printing of biting_gale_blue (same .drafts folder); identical printed text, so copied verbatim per the copy-an-existing-spelling rule - only the slug and the fusion flag name differ, because ability_keywords.fusion keys the marker on card.slug ('fused_<card.slug>', ability_keywords.py:604) and FLAG_SET tests the source controller's current_turn_effects (condition_types.py:1004). Full reasoning for deviating from the triage list's PITCHED_FOR_THIS (fusion is a reveal that never stamps pitched_for_this; FLAG_SET fused_<slug> is the verified live idiom) is in biting_gale_blue.json's _comment. Adopter note: batch labels this printing's set 'OldhimBlitzDeck' - pick the json/<set>/ folder from the card's setIdentifiers per IMPLEMENTATION_GUIDE step 4, not from that label.
